theme: Client Trust Built Over Repeat Engagements

linkedin.text:
The metric we're most proud of isn't the number of events we've produced — though 1,500+ across 130+ destinations over 16 years is a number we stand behind. It's the clients who come back. Repeat engagements from HR directors, marketing VPs, and sales leaders who've seen what happens when logistics, creativity, and cultural intelligence all fire at once. They don't need to be sold a second time. If you're evaluating event partners and want to speak with someone who's been in the room more than once — let's connect. Happy to make an introduction.
